title: Improve autonomous task generation
task: Autonomous strategic goal: improve goal generation so Jarvis creates useful follow-up tasks after every run, deduplicates repeated goals, scores priority/risk, and avoids looping on the same task forever.
success_criteria: Goal queue contains prioritized non-duplicate tasks.
Night Mode can consume generated goals.

title: Reduce compiled_only outcomes
task: Autonomous strategic goal: inspect why recent tasks ended as compiled_only and add a safe execution adapter or clearer blocked reason.

title: Improve memory learning usefulness
task: Autonomous strategic goal: summarize recent execution lessons into actionable improvements. Detect repeated failures, repeated completed-only runs, and missing evidence patterns.
success_criteria: Next tasks are proposed from lessons.

title: Improve Telegram operator experience
task: Autonomous strategic goal: improve Telegram UX so Jarvis answers status questions clearly, does not hallucinate links, finds tasks by fuzzy text, and sends concise completion messages without spam.
success_criteria: Task lookup UX is improved or planned.

title: Improve n8n dynamic pipeline intelligence
task: Autonomous strategic goal: inspect latest n8n workflow artifacts and improve dynamic pipeline templates. Avoid fallback Echo workflow for complex automation requests. Prefer validate -> action -> transform -> report.
success_criteria: Dynamic pipeline does not degrade into Echo for complex requests.
Workflow result includes workflow_id and status.
